newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy welfare reform talks to start June 18 - union.
newsitem.headline: Italy welfare reform talks to start June 18 - union.

text.p: The Italian government is to start negotiations with trade unions and employers on reforming the welfare state on June 18, a trade union official said on Thursday.
The official said agreement to start the talks was reached at a meeting with the government this morning. The government also held separate talks with employers.
He said the government was expected to officially announce a start date for the talks later on Thursday.
Prime Minister Romano Prodi is putting the finishing touches to a three-year economic strategy, known as the DPEF, which the government is due to adopt at a cabinet meeting on Friday.
